name: lemon-agent
description: Lemon Agent — free tools, honest measurements, agentic services. Static site + canonical failure lists.

scripts.sync: mkdir -p public/lists public/guides public/examples public/start public/craft && cp lists/*.md public/lists/ && cp -R guides/. public/guides/ && cp examples/*.json public/examples/ && cp start/*.md public/start/ && cp craft/*.md public/craft/ && cp lists/prose-failure-list.md skills/prose-failure-list/list.md && cp lists/agent-workflow-failure-list.md skills/agent-workflow-failure-list/list.md
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=lemon-agent --branch=main
